downside.label: Workers lose while capital rises
downside.title: The gains go one way. The losses go another.
downside.explanation: Automation raises the return to capital while cutting worker income. People who own the assets gain; people who live on wages lose.

upside.label: Both gain, but capital gains more
upside.title: Workers can gain and still fall behind.
upside.explanation: The divide does not require falling wages. It also appears when automation helps everyone but sends a much larger share of the gains to capital owners.

together.label: Workers and capital rise together
together.title: Sometimes the gains are shared.
together.explanation: When wages and capital income move together, public ownership adds less. The case for it is strongest when the two sides pull apart.
